narrative.overview: The site presents healthcare data and AI consulting as an operating system: business decisions, governed data products, model/provider strategy, workflow automation, measurement, documentation, and handoff working as one accountable layer. The first viewport should show this as a clean operating model, not a decorative diagram.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, diagrammatic surfaces with strong borders.
Red, amber, and green status language tied to risk, governance, and readiness.
Evidence through diagnostics, working artifacts, controls, and operating cadence.

rules.name: The No Default Healthcare Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue gradients do not belong on this site unless a future brand decision explicitly changes the palette.

rules.name: The Signal Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, and green must describe risk, governance, readiness, or action. Do not use them as random decoration.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section headings do not use kicker labels. The heading must carry its own weight.

rules.name: The No Overlap Rule
rules.body: Hero artifacts must use stable rows or panels. Do not use overlapping text, decorative route lines, or map-like clutter.

dos: Do sell the company Data AI Operating System as the flagship mechanism.
Do tie AI copy to data readiness, governance, workflow fit, model/provider strategy, and measurable business action.
Do lead with artifact evidence: decision memos, working builds, control packages, measurement, and handoff.
Do keep section spacing generous and content blocks scan-friendly.
donts: Don't invent client logos, testimonials, prices, certifications, or revenue outcomes.
Don't name private systems or private projects as public case studies.
Don't use public code links as primary conversion proof.
Don't use generic AI agency language, purple gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative icon cards.
